questions.q: A stone is thrown at $25\text{m} / \text{s}$ at ${53}^{o}$ above the horizontal. At what time its velocity is at ${45}^{o}$ below the horizontal?
questions.solution:
Horizontal component of velocity, throughout the motion remain constant

using $ucos\theta = vcos\alpha$

$25cos ⁡ 53 ° = vcos ⁡ 45 °$

$⟹ v = 25 \times \dfrac{3}{5}. \sqrt{2}$

$= 15\sqrt{2}$

$⟹ {v}_{y} = vsin ⁡ 45 = 15$

Now using ${V}_{y} = {u}_{y} + {a}_{y}tiny -$ direction,

$- 15 = 25sin ⁡ 53° - gt$

$- 15 =25 \times \dfrac{4}{5} - 10t$

$⟹ t = 3.5\text\sec$

questions.q: A ball rolls off the top of stair-way with a horizontal velocity of magnitude $1.8\mathrm\mathrm\mathrm\mathrm\mathrm\mathrm\mathrm\mathrm\mathrm\mathrm\mathrm{ms}^{-1}.$ The steps are $0.20\text{m}$ high and $0.20\text{m}$ wide. Which step will the ball hit first?
questions.solution:
Given, $x = 0.20m, y = 0.20m, u = 1.8\mathrm\mathrm\mathrm\mathrm\mathrm\mathrm\mathrm\mathrm\mathrm\mathrm\mathrm{ms}^{-1}$

Let the ball strike the $n$ th step of stairs,

Vertical distance travelled $= \text{n}\text{y}$

Using equation of motion in y-direction

$s = ut + \dfrac{1}{2}at^{2}$

$⟹- ny = 0-\dfrac{1}{2}gt^{2}$...(1)

Horizontal distance travelled $= nx$

$⟹ \text{n}\text{x} = ut$

$⟹ t = \dfrac{nx}{u}$...(2)

using (1) and (2)

$ny = \dfrac{1}{2}g{\left(\dfrac{nx}{u}\right)}^{2}$

$orn = \dfrac{2u^{2}}{g}\dfrac{y}{x^{2}}= 3.3 ⟹ {4}^{th}stair$

questions.q: Two particles are projected simultaneously in the same vertical plane, from the same point, but with different speeds and at different angles with horizontal. The path followed by one, as seen by the other is
options: a straight line making a constant angle with the horizontal
questions.solution:
Let ${\overset{→}{u}}_{1}$ and ${\overset{→}{u}}_{2}$ be the initial velocities of the two particles and ${θ}_{1}$ and ${θ}_{2}$ be their angles of projection with the horizontal

The velocities of the two particles after time $t$ are,

${\overset{→}{v}}_{1} = \left({u ⁡}_{1} cos {θ}_{1}\right) \overset{^}{i} + \left({u ⁡}_{1} sin {θ}_{1} - \text{g} \text{t}\right) \overset{^}{j}$ and

${\overset{→}{v}}_{1} = \left({u ⁡}_{1} cos {θ}_{1}\right) \overset{^}{i} + \left({u ⁡}_{2} sin {θ}_{2} - \text{g} \text{t}\right) \overset{^}{j}$

Their relative velocity is ${\overset{→}{v}}_{1 2} = {\overset{→}{v}}_{1} - {\overset{→}{v}}_{2}$

$= \left({u ⁡}_{1} cos {θ}_{1} - {u ⁡}_{2} cos {θ}_{1}\right) \overset{^}{i} + \left({u ⁡}_{1} sin {θ}_{1} - {u ⁡}_{2} sin {θ}_{2}\right) \overset{^}{j}$

Which is a constant. So the path followed by one, as seen by the other is a straight line, making a constant angle with the horizontal

questions.q: Two particles are projected from a point at the same instant with velocities whose horizontal components and vertical components are $\left({u}_{1}, {v}_{1}\right)$ and $\left({u}_{2}, {v}_{2}\right)$ respectively. The time interval between their passing through the other common point of their path (other than origin) is
questions.solution:
The time for particle 1 to pass through common point of their path

${t}_{1} = \dfrac{x}{{u}_{1}}$

The time for particle 2 to pass through common point of their path

${t}_{2} = \dfrac{x}{{u}_{2}}$

Difference of time $t = {t}_{1} - {t}_{2}$

Time $t = \dfrac{x}{{u}_{1}} - \dfrac{x}{{u}_{2}} = x\left(\dfrac{1}{{u}_{1}} - \dfrac{1}{{u}_{2}}\right)$

$y = xtan\theta - \dfrac{g{x}^{2}}{2{u}_{x}^{2}}$

$y = x\dfrac{{v}_{1}}{{u}_{1}} - \dfrac{g{x}^{2}}{2{u}_{1}^{2}} = x\dfrac{{v}_{2}}{{u}_{2}} - \dfrac{g{x}^{2}}{2{u}_{2}^{2}}$

$\dfrac{{v}_{1}}{{u}_{1}} - \dfrac{{v}_{2}}{{u}_{2}} = x\dfrac{g}{2}\left(\dfrac{1}{{u}_{1}^{2}} - \dfrac{1}{{u}_{2}^{2}}\right)$

$\dfrac{{v}_{1}}{{u}_{1}} - \dfrac{{v}_{2}}{{u}_{2}} = x\dfrac{g}{2}\left(\dfrac{1}{{u}_{1}} + \dfrac{1}{{u}_{2}}\right)\left(\dfrac{1}{{u}_{1}} - \dfrac{1}{{u}_{2}}\right)$

$t = x\left(\dfrac{1}{{u}_{1}} - \dfrac{1}{{u}_{2}}\right) = \dfrac{2}{g}\left(\dfrac{{v}_{1}{u}_{2} - {v}_{2}{u}_{1}}{{u}_{1} + {u}_{2}}\right)$
